headline: Approved the 2027 monthly meeting schedule; members agreed to review more information on automated license plate reading technology before future action.
summary: Members discussed automated license plate reading technology, data center developments, and Veterans Day planning. They agreed more information should be reviewed before future action on license plate reading technology. Commissioners approved the 2027 monthly meeting schedule.
decisions: Approved the 2027 monthly meeting schedule, with meetings on the second Thursday of each month at 7:00 PM.
Agreed that additional information should be reviewed on automated license plate reading technology before future action.

decision_evidence.quote: Commissioners approved the 2027 monthly meeting schedule.
Members agreed additional information should be reviewed prior to future action.

plain_text:
TOWN OF HAMDEN, CONNECTICUT 
 
Human Rights & Relations Commission 
Minutes         
         
Special Meeting 
 
7:15 PM, September 29, 2026 
  
 
Hamden Government 
Center 
Third Floor Conference 
Room 
2750 Dixwell Avenue 
Hamden, CT  06518 
Tel:  (203) 287-7070 
Fax:  (203) 287-7075 
 Click to View Agenda   
  
1. CALL TO ORDER   
 The meeting was called to order promptly at 7:05 PM by Chair, Claudia LeSueur.   
2. ATTENDANCE   
 Attendance was taken by the B&C clerk Porsche Edmundson. 
Present Claud LeSueur, Ganiyu Mimiko, Dana Parmelee Guzman, Tiffany Artis 
Wilson. 
3. PUBLIC COMMENT   
 
 
4. APPROVAL OF PREVIOUS MEETING MINUTES   
 Minutes approval for the September 29th special meeting. 
5. CORRESPONDENCE   
 
1. September RSVP's and the event went well.  
 
6. REPORTS   
 
1. Commission members discussed opportunities to strengthen partnerships 
with local organizations and community stakeholders.  
2. Members will research and compile a calendar of community events to 
identify opportunities for outreach, participation, and collaboration. 
 
7. EXECUTIVE SESSION 
(if recommended by the town attorney)  
 
 
8. OLD BUSINESS   
 The October 8th meeting with police Chief Reynold is confirmed. 
October 20th: Teen Violence Prevention presentation with Dave Wolffe. 
November 17th IRIS presentation confirmed. 
 
Commissioners approved the 2027 monthly meeting schedule. Meetings will be held
On the second Thursday of each month at 7:00 PM on the following dates. 
January 14th, February 11th, March 11th, April 8th, May 13th, June 10th, July 8th, 
August 12th, September 9th, October 14th, November 11th, December 9th. 
9. NEW BUSINESS   
  New Haven Legal Assistance meeting on Nov 12TH.  
 
Discussion focused on public safety benefits, privacy concerns, and community 
awareness regarding the use of automated license plate reading technology. 
Members agreed additional information should be reviewed prior to future action. 
 
The Data Centers Commission discussed the data center developments and their 
potential impact on communities, including infrastructure, land use, environmental 
considerations, and public transparency. 
 
Veterans Day Recognition: The 
 The Commission discussed planning and recognition activities related to Veterans 
Day and acknowledged the importance of honoring local veterans within the 
community. 
 
The law enforcement engagement members welcomed planned participation from 
representatives of the Hampton Police Department and future meetings to support 
dialog and community engagement efforts.  
10. ADJOURNMENT   
 Commissioner and Chair, Claudia LeSueur, moved to adjourn the Meeting at 7:42 PM, and 
Dana Parmelee Guzman seconded the motion; all were in favor.  
 
Human Relations and Human Rights Commission, Town of Hamden, CT. 
 
B&C Clerk Porsche Edmundson
